visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair sits on a gray couch in a dimly lit room, holding a snack box. He looks up at a large flat-screen TV which displays the bright blue Disney+ logo against a white background. (2) The man's eyes widen in surprise. The TV shows a clip from a drama featuring a young girl in a plaid shirt looking at someone off-camera. The man holds a small rectangular box of chocolates. (3) A close-up shows the man's hands opening the 'Gannibal' themed chocolate box to reveal dark, spherical chocolate pieces inside. On the TV, the show continues with a shot of a hand holding a similar box. (4) The man pulls a colorful, patterned blanket over his head, appearing frightened. The screen transitions to a black background with red and white text for 'Gannibal Season 2'. (5) The man is now outdoors in a park with tall, leafless trees and a gray sky. He wears a dark purple knit sweater and olive pants, looking around nervously. (6) Rapid cuts show characters from the series: a man with a rifle in the woods, an elderly man peeking through a wooden door, and a close-up of intense eyes through a fence. The man in the park reacts to these 'visions'. (7) The man is back indoors, first dusting a glass cabinet filled with collectibles and then using a cordless vacuum on a light-colored wooden floor. He looks exhausted and lies down. (8) He peeks from behind a white wall in his hallway, looking terrified. The TV in the background shows a monster-like figure with long grey hair reaching out. (9) The man is under his blanket again, watching a montage of intense show clips featuring police cars, people shouting, and the grey-haired monster. His face is partially hidden by the blanket. (10) The final screen shows the Disney+ logo and promotional text in Chinese regarding the season finale of 'Gannibal'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the iconic Disney+ chime. A suspenseful orchestral track featuring low strings and a rhythmic percussion beat fades in. A male voice speaks in Mandarin with a casual, curious tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effects transition. BGM swells with dissonant violin stabs. A young girl's voice is heard speaking Japanese softly. (3) Sound of cardboard rustling as a box is opened. The man makes a short, breathy vocalization of surprise. (4) Dramatic impact SFX coinciding with visual cuts. High-pitched synthesizer 'risers' build tension. A loud, aggressive male voice shouts in Japanese from the TV clip. (5) Outdoor ambient wind noise and soft footstep sounds on gravel. The BGM shifts to a more eerie, ambient texture with minimal melody. (6) A sudden 'ding' or bell-like SFX punctuates a realization. The vacuum cleaner hum introduces a loud, broadband mechanical noise for several seconds. (7) A loud, terrifying monster shriek or distorted vocal SFX occurs. BGM reaches a peak of harmonic tension with fast-paced strings. (8) The man lets out an audible groan of exhaustion. The BGM fades into a final brand stinger jingle as promotional text is displayed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Immersion Experience -> Comic Relief -> Final Promotion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative advertisement for the Disney+ series 'Gannibal'. It uses a humorous 'reaction' format where the viewer's immersion in the show is so intense that he begins to hallucinate characters and monsters from the series in his daily life. The goal is to highlight the suspenseful and gripping nature of the show's second season.
